sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC directory identifies Organization (P-5) Query as a named oil-and-gas route and says online query data is continually updated, informational, non-authoritative, and without legal force.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records the named route, access time, and published limitation without treating a query result as complete, legally controlling, connected to private property, or sufficient for a downstream conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, About Oil & Gas Data Queries (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official overview describes the Organization (P-5) route, the organization-information context, operator-name or number search, and daily-update context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses those source-stated categories only to build a criteria snapshot and record displayed labels; it does not interpret an organization or P-5 record.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil & Gas Data Query (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Oil & Gas Data Query menu presents Organization (P-5) Query as a separate route from production, wellbore, severance, proration, P-4, inactive-well, orphan-well, drilling-permit, inspection, and violation routes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves that route identity so records from separate systems are not merged or mislabeled.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Organization (P-5) Query (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official public Organization (P-5) Query entry displays its current operator-selection, organization-status, organization-type, and P-5-related date criteria labels and the route used for one query attempt.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records only criteria actually used, navigation steps that occurred, and bounded retrieval state. It does not submit a filing or reproduce an actual property query.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, About P-5 Organization Query (accessed 2026-08-24)
